question: In which of the following years, NABARD sanctions Action Research Project to MYRADA?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1987**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• MYRADA, an **NGO based in Karnataka**, was involved in helping resettle landless laborers and rural poor.
 
• Through this project, NABARD and MYRADA experimented with the concept of Self-Help Groups (SHGs), which evolved into a significant **microfinance **movement in India.
 
• The aim of the Action Research Project was to assess how informal groups, primarily consisting of women, could self-manage resources, promote savings, and provide loans to group members.
 
• This initiative led to the creation of a system where rural communities, especially women, were empowered to control financial activities, leading to better financial inclusion.
 
• The success of the project encouraged NABARD to replicate and promote the SHG model across India, making it a vital component of rural credit structures and one of the largest microfinance programs in the world.
